correctness.rationale: For simple K_{m,m}, the grounded Laplacian is injective in individual edge weights; strict logdet concavity forces a unique optimum. Permutations of paired vertices and side exchange give two conductance orbits a,b and b>0. Laplacian spectral factorization yields tau=(a+(m-1)b)(mb)^(m-1)(2a+(m-2)b)^(m-1)/m. Budget b=B/[m(Pt+(m-1)Q)], t=a/b. The derivative of log tau has sign opposite to quadratic 2t^2+[4(m-1)-2m Q/P]t+[(m-2)(2m-1)-m(2m-3)Q/P]. At and above threshold all terms nonnegative for t>=0; below threshold one unique positive root. Expansion P/Q=1+gamma/m leads t->max(0,1-gamma). Independently compared full grounded-Laplacian exact determinants for m=3,4 and polynomial derivative. m=2 is excluded because deleting matching disconnects.
